snippet.title: Vale's Echo - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Vale’s Echo is a 2D cozy horror adventure where a dead girl and a talking skull journey through the underworld to confront her fears, traumas, and buried truths. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that shape her path as you guide Vale through this dark afterlife. Will regret follow her into eternity?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564990/Vales_Echo/
Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/vP6vTZaf9f
Sign up for playtest queue and news: https://hollowbeak.com/#newsletter
